defects.description: Detector flagged reclining (globalTilt missing) but description says Sit on the floor — seated floor pose with one leg extended, NOT reclining.

Description says one leg extended straight ahead angled slightly away from square-to-camera, and the other bent with foot flat near opposite knee. Baseline has both legs symmetric (hip 80/80, knee 100/90, hipAbduct 0/0) — NEITHER leg extended, NEITHER angled, NEITHER crosses to opposite knee.
Description says Plant one hand on the floor behind you. Baseline has shoulderFwdL:+7 (slight backward) and elbow 65° (bent) — leftWrist at z=+0.087 (forward of body), NOT planted behind.
Description says lift the chest. Baseline spine:+8 (slight forward lean) — chest not lifted. Lifted chest requires slight backward spine arch (negative spine).
